tests.name: Hour 15 - Capstone planning workshop - scope, milestones, and delivery path
command:
import importlib.util, json, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
source = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
workspace = Path(tmp.name) / 'workspace'
shutil.copytree(source.parent, workspace, dirs_exist_ok=True)
script = workspace / source.name
run_ok = False
try:
    result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, script.name], cwd=workspace, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=25)
    run_ok = result.returncode == 0
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
    run_ok = False
plan_path = workspace / 'planning_artifacts' / 'hour15_capstone_plan.json'
rubric_path = workspace / 'planning_artifacts' / 'hour15_rubric.md'
plan_data = {}
plan_artifact_ok = False
if plan_path.exists():
    try:
        plan_data = json.loads(plan_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
        plan_artifact_ok = isinstance(plan_data, dict) and isinstance(plan_data.get('milestones'), list) and len(plan_data.get('milestones', [])) >= 2 and isinstance(plan_data.get('definition_of_done'), list) and len(plan_data.get('definition_of_done', [])) >= 3 and all(plan_data.get(key) for key in ('domain', 'interface', 'scope_guardrail'))
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        plan_artifact_ok = False
rubric_ok = rubric_path.exists() and 'Definition of Done' in rubric_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
behavior_ok = False
try:
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('advanced_day4_module', script)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    func = getattr(module, 'plan_ready_for_build', None)
    if callable(func) and plan_artifact_ok:
        invalid = dict(plan_data)
        invalid['milestones'] = []
        behavior_ok = (func(plan_data) is True) and (func(invalid) is False)
except Exception:
    behavior_ok = False
print(f'guardrail_hour15_run_ok={run_ok}')
print(f'guardrail_hour15_plan_artifact_ok={plan_artifact_ok}')
print(f'guardrail_hour15_rubric_artifact_ok={rubric_ok}')
print(f'guardrail_hour15_behavior_ok={behavior_ok}')
tmp.cleanup()
